blocks.text: Setting up your Mac for Google Sheets

Google Sheets does not have a native Mac app. You should use Google Chrome for the best experience. Open sheets.google.com in Chrome. Click the three-dot menu at the top right. Select Save and Share, then Install page as app. This creates a dedicated window for your spreadsheets. It keeps your research data separate from your browser tabs.

Data cleaning takes most of your time. Start by using the right tools. Use Data > Split text to columns to fix messy imports. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to find and replace values quickly. If you have duplicates, use Data > Data cleanup > Remove duplicates. This saves hours of manual work.

Google Sheets supports up to 20 million cells. Large sheets can get slow. Avoid complex array formulas in every cell. Use filter views to see specific data without changing the main sheet. If your sheet lags, try to split your data into smaller files by region or survey date.

Charts help you explain data to stakeholders. Select your data range. Go to Insert > Chart. Use the Chart editor to change types. You can create bar, line, or pie charts. Always label your axes clearly. Use consistent colors for your brand or client report.

Share your work using the Share button. Set permissions to Viewer, Commenter, or Editor. Avoid giving Editor access to everyone. Use comments to discuss specific data points. This keeps the conversation attached to the numbers. Check revision history if you need to see who changed a cell.

Always double check your ranges. If you use VLOOKUP, ensure your search key is in the first column of your range. Use IFERROR to hide errors in your final report. This makes your sheets look professional.
How to work faster with Lazur

Lazur helps you stay in your flow. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about menu items. Ask where the filter button is. Lazur draws a circle around it. Use the fn key to dictate notes into a cell. You can also ask Lazur to explain how to write a complex formula. It keeps your hands on the keyboard.

faq.question: Is there an official Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google Sheets is a web-based tool. You can create a shortcut in Chrome to open it in its own window.

faq.question: How many cells can I use in Google Sheets?
faq.answer: You can use up to 20 million cells per spreadsheet.

faq.question: How do I see all shortcuts in Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + / on your Mac to open the shortcut menu.

faq.question: Does Lazur edit my Google Sheets files?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not edit files. It points at buttons and guides you, but you perform the actions.
